title: 1988 Fleer #539 Tom Glavine Atlanta Braves Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 1988 Tom Glavine Fleer #539 Rookie card is a must-have for any baseball card collector. Featuring a member of the Major League Baseball (MLB) Hall of Fame, this card showcases Glavine in his early years with the Atlanta Braves. The card is part of the 1988 Fleer set and is a base set rookie card, making it even more valuable to collectors. 

With its crisp design and quality printing, this sports trading card is a great addition to any collection. It's perfect for fans of the Braves or anyone who appreciates a good rookie card. Don't miss out on the chance to add this card to your collection.
